reason: A floating music player for DeepSeek Harness that searches and imports NetEase Cloud Music content, streams tracks, and supports both UI and chat-based playback controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可拖动的悬浮音乐播放器，支持搜索和导入网易云音乐内容，并通过界面或对话控制播放。
summaries.en: A draggable floating music player for DeepSeek Harness that searches and imports NetEase Cloud Music content and supports playback control through the interface or chat.

capabilities: imports playlists by link or ID
provides a draggable floating player interface
connects to third-party music APIs and optional proxy services
accepts optional music-service login cookies through environment variables
